🗂 We’re Hiring: Developer / DevOps Engineer
🕒 Employment Type: Full-Time
💼 Level: Entry-Level to Senior Level
We are seeking a skilled and proactive Developer / DevOps Engineer to support software development, deployment automation, infrastructure management, and system reliability. This role combines software engineering expertise with DevOps practices to build, deploy, monitor, and maintain scalable and secure applications and infrastructure.
🎯 Key Responsibilities
• Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications, services, and automation solutions.
• Build and manage CI/CD pipelines to streamline software delivery and deployment processes.
• Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, and deployment workflows.
• Monitor system performance, application health, and infrastructure reliability.
• Collaborate with developers, QA teams, product managers, and system administrators throughout the software development lifecycle.
• Troubleshoot and resolve application, infrastructure, deployment, and performance issues.
• Manage cloud environments and infrastructure resources across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or similar platforms.
• Implement security best practices, access controls, and compliance requirements.
• Support containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes.
• Maintain system documentation, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks.
• Optimize application scalability, availability, performance, and disaster recovery capabilities.
• Continuously improve automation, monitoring, and operational efficiency processes.
✅ Requirements
• Experience in software development, DevOps, site reliability engineering (SRE), or related fields.
• Proficiency in one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, C#, or similar.
• Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
• Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Experience with containerization technologies including Docker and Kubernetes.
• Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, CloudFormation, or similar.
• Understanding of Linux systems, networking concepts, and system administration.
• Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog, or similar.
• Strong troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills.
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
🌟 What We Offer
• Opportunity to work with modern cloud infrastructure, automation technologies, and scalable software systems.
• Exposure to DevOps, cloud engineering, site reliability, and software development best practices.
• Career progression into Senior DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer (SRE), Cloud Architect, Platform Engineer, Engineering Manager, or CTO roles.
• A collaborative, innovative, and technology-driven work environment.
• Training, certification sponsorship, and professional development opportunities.
• Competitive compensation, performance incentives, and comprehensive benefits package.

description_preview:
About Cloudwick
Cloudwick is an AWS-certified data and AI company that helps organizations modernize how they manage and use data. Since 2010, we've worked with enterprises and public sector organizations to build secure, scalable data platforms and AI solutions that solve real operational problems.
Amorphic Data Platform
Amorphic is Cloudwick's cloud-native platform for modern data and AI operations. It runs securely in customer AWS environments and brings together data ingestion, cataloging, access control, governance, and AI enablement in one place. The goal is straightforward: make it easier for organizations to get value from their data without stitching together a long list of tools or taking on unnecessary infrastructure overhead. Amorphic is built with security, usability, and compliance in mind, and is designed for organizations running sensitive and mission-critical workloads.
Amorphic Intelligent Automation Solutions
Our Intelligent Automation solutions help organizations reduce repetitive, manual work through AI-powered automation. Typical use cases include intelligent document processing, workflow automation, case summarization, reporting, routing, and decision support. The focus is on helping teams move faster without a major system overhaul.
About the Role
We’re hiring a
Software Engineering Intern, AI Solutions
starting this fall. This is a part-time internship (around 20 hours per week) designed to fit alongside your class schedule, with the option to increase hours over academic breaks. There’s no fixed end date: the internship continues as long as it’s working well for both sides, whether that’s one semester or well beyond. This is not a shadow-and-observe internship. You’ll write real code that ships to real customers, working on AI-powered applications: chat assistants, retrieval and document search, agentic workflows, and document-processing pipelines, all built with Python on AWS. You’ll work directly with senior engineers on a small US-based team, get substantive code review, and see how AI products actually get built, evaluated, and delivered, from early prototype through customer feedback. We’re looking for someone who is curious, self-directed, and excited about building with LLMs, and who wants more ownership and faster feedback than a large-company internship typically offers.
Responsibilities
Build and ship features for AI-enabled applications under the guidance of senior engineers
Write backend code in Python: APIs, data flows, and services that support AI workflows
Contribute to AI evaluation work: helping build test suites, golden datasets, and harnesses that measure whether our AI features actually work well
Prototype quickly: try out new models, tools, and approaches, and share what you learn with the team
Help test and debug across the stack, and turn bugs you find into automated tests
Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and team planning
Write clear documentation for the things you build
Qualifications
Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field
Required Skills
Solid programming fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and the ability to write clean, working Python
Familiarity with the basics of building software collaboratively: git, pull requests, and testing
Genuine interest in LLMs and AI applications, demonstrated through coursework, personal projects, hackathons, or self-driven exploration
Ability to work independently, ask good questions, and make progress without constant direction
Strong written and verbal communication
Able to commit approximately 20 hours per week during the semester
Preferred Skills
Personal or class projects using LLM APIs, RAG, agents, or prompt-based applications
Exposure to AWS or other cloud platforms
Experience with web frameworks, REST APIs, or databases
Prior internship or substantial project experience
Interest in continuing across multiple semesters or going full-time over academic breaks
Work Location
Bay Area, United States
Mostly remote, with occasional in-person collaboration in the Bay Area
Flexible scheduling around your classes
Compensation
This is a paid internship with competitive hourly compensation ($30-$45 range). Strong performers may be considered for return internships or full-time roles.
Equal Opportunity Statement
We are committed to diversity and inclusivity in our hiring practices.

title: Domain Tech Lead — Infrastructure Patching Automation (Mainframe & AS/400)
description_preview:
Domain Tech Lead - Infrastructure Patching Automation (Mainframe & AS/400)
Join our AI & Engineering team by transforming technology platforms, driving innovation, and helping make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll collaborate with talented professionals, reimagining and re-engineering operations and processes that are critical to business. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation and enhanced productivity.
AI & Engineering leverages innovative engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology and data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.
Recruiting for this role ends on 8/21/26.
Work you'll do
As a Domain Tech Lead on the AI & Engineering Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure team, you will own end-to-end technical delivery within a specific infrastructure domain on a large-scale infrastructure engineering engagement, with a focus on automating the patching lifecycle of multiple infrastructure areas. This is an engineering execution role - you are responsible for delivery outcomes within your domain, not just coordination across them.Our practitioners work collaboratively within integrated, cross-functional teams. You will provide hands-on technical design guidance to your engineering team, drive sprint-level delivery, and coordinate with adjacent infrastructure and engineering domains. You will be expected to solve architecture and integration problems that your engineers bring to you, and to surface domain-level risk before it becomes a program-level issue. Domain openings are available across: Database (Oracle, SQL, MongoDB, Redis, Postgres), Middleware, Cloud (AWS/Azure), Network, End User Compute, and Mainframe.
This role requires deep expertise in mainframe and AS/400 (IBM i) environments to lead and deliver the patch management program across complex legacy and hybrid infrastructure estates, develop automation solutions that reduce manual effort and risk, and serve as a trusted technical advisor to enterprise clients - working closely with client stakeholders, project managers, and cross-functional delivery teams to plan, schedule, and execute patch cycles while ensuring compliance, stability, and security across mission-critical platforms.
Own the creation and execution of a technical execution plan for your domain - maintaining delivery commitments and proactively surfacing risks
Provide hands-on technical design guidance to unblock infrastructure automation engineering: architecture decisions, integration patterns, implementation approaches
Lead detailed design and drive execution of infrastructure test harnesses, infrastructure automation engineering, and deployment capabilities within your domain
Lead technical decisions within your domain, ensuring solutions are standardized and production-scalable
Drive PI planning, backlog prioritization, and sprint-level adjustments with engineering throughput as the primary success metric
Coordinate with the Testing Platform team on infrastructure onboarding, test suite migration, and CI/CD pipeline integration
Manage cross-domain dependencies and represent your domain's delivery status to program leadership and client stakeholders
Develop junior team members through direct coaching, design reviews, and structured feedback
Patch Delivery - Mainframe & AS/400 Infrastructure
Design, plan, and execute end-to-end patch delivery program for IBM z/OS mainframe and IBM i (AS/400) environments
Manage the patch lifecycle end to end: identification, testing, scheduling, application, and post-implementation validation
Understand patch windows across development, QA, and production environments
Maintain patch compliance dashboards and KPIs
Automation Engineering - Mainframe Environments
Coordinate automation frameworks to streamline patch identification, scheduling, and deployment on z/OS and IBM i systems
Design automation pipelines with enterprise tooling (e.g., IBM Tivoli, CA7, TWS/OPC, ServiceNow, SDSF) to reduce manual touchpoints
Design automated compliance checks, health monitoring, and alert frameworks for patch-related activities
Coordinate with DevOps teams to incorporate mainframe automation into CI/CD pipelines where applicable
Client-Facing Consulting
Serve as a primary technical point of contact for client stakeholders across mainframe leadership, infrastructure, and security teams
Lead requirements-gathering workshops and translate business objectives into infrastructure delivery roadmaps
Manage client expectations and proactively communicate risks, dependencies, and change management considerations
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
Ability to lead projects or workstreams
Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
Ability to meet deadlines
Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others
The team
AI & Engineering helps organizations transform technology platforms, modernize critical operations, and drive innovation at scale. Professionals across the practice work with clients to improve performance, launch new digital capabilities, and increase productivity through engineering-led solutions.
